_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: open.mp
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: open.mp, the multiplayer mod for Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. It runs SA-MP gamemodes and filterscripts, and SA-MP clients can join. Put your gamemodes in gamemodes and set them in config.json.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# open.mp. Downloads the open.mp server from GitHub, checked against
# GitHub's checksum. The server and its components are replaced; config.json,
# bans, scripts and the user's gamemodes are never touched (the release's
# example gamemodes are only added when missing).
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
repo=openmultiplayer/open.mp
[ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ] || { echo "open.mp's Linux server only runs on x86 (amd64) nodes."; exit 1; }

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$want" = latest ] || want="v${want#v}"
tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want") ||
    { echo "open.mp has no release ${VERSION}. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as v1.6.7.3218."; exit 1; }
asset=open.mp-linux-x86.tar.gz
sum=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag" | awk -v a="$asset" '$1 == a { print $2 }')
[ -n "$sum" ] || { echo "open.mp ${tag#v} has no Linux download."; exit 1; }
if [ "$(cat .raptor-omp 2>/dev/null)" = "$sum" ] && [ -x omp-server ]; then
    echo "open.mp ${tag#v} is already installed."
    exit 0
fi

build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$build"
mkdir -p "$build"
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
echo "Downloading open.mp ${tag#v}"
gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" "$build/omp.tar.gz"
tar -xzf "$build/omp.tar.gz" -C "$build"
new="$build/Server"
[ -x "$new/omp-server" ] || { echo "The download has no omp-server in it."; exit 1; }
# The server itself and its components are replaced.
rm -rf components
mv "$new/components" components
mv -f "$new/omp-server" omp-server
# Everything else is the user's: only added where missing.
cp -an "$new/." .
echo "$sum" > .raptor-omp
echo "Installed open.mp ${tag#v}."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The open.mp release to install, such as v1.6.7.3218, or latest.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players connected at once.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: The password for remote administration. RCON stays off until you turn it on in config.json.
